workflows.description: Explain the generated project plugin, roles, workflows, and evidence model.
Create an evidence-backed plan before changing project artifacts.
Verify project output against its declared quality contract.
Perform an independent review of the current requested scope.
Persist new durable project knowledge without duplicating sources.
Report project kit health, unresolved questions, and generated-file status.
Collect and rank evidence for a project question.
Analyse evidence while separating facts, inference, and unknowns.
Synthesize approved analysis into the requested deliverable.
Create or revise a document under project source and quality rules.
Diagnose unexpected software behavior before implementing a fix.
Simplify changed code without changing behavior.
